messages.content: Hi, this is your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope you're doing okay out there. Have you had a chance to check your blood pressure this week?
Every time I put the cuff on it just says ERR. Been like that for two days now. I got no idea what's wrong with it

Ugh, that's frustrating. I have to be straight with you — device troubleshooting isn't something I'm able to help with. Your best bet is the number printed on the cuff itself, or whoever supplied it to you. Setting the device aside for a second, how are you feeling otherwise? Any headaches, dizziness, or anything else on your mind?
No I feel alright. Just annoyed I can't get a number. Been taking my pills every morning like usual

Good to hear you're feeling okay and staying on top of your medication. I'll make a note that we weren't able to log a reading this week because of the device error. I'll get your next check-in scheduled. Hope you get that cuff sorted out soon — take care!
